daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

Trade minister AHY dismissed concerns about former President Jokowi's regional tour, stating that the 2029 election is still far away and three years off. Labour union leader Said Iqbal expressed optimism that Partai Buruh will secure 5-7 seats in the 2029 legislative elections. Meanwhile, Home Affairs Minister Tito urged strengthening the role of BNPP to accelerate border development and security.

  • The Home Affairs Minister appreciated Commission II DPR RI's support for strengthening border regions.
  • The MPR is pushing for direct flights between Indonesia and Uzbekistan to enhance bilateral ties.
  • A minister dismissed rumors that two Nunukan villages would join Malaysia, calling them unfounded.
  • Commissioner Pigai revealed that the draft Human Rights Bill will grant Komnas HAM investigative powers including forced summons.
  • Commission VIII chairman called for optimizing waqf to reduce dependence on social assistance programs.
  • The DPR and government will discuss tomorrow mining work plans that triggered layoffs.
  • A Constitutional Court judge warned students not to treat judicial review applications casually.

Foreign Policy & Defence

A joint TNI-Polri patrol seized weapons in Central Papua as part of ongoing security operations in the region. The Ministry of Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers welcomed home trafficking victims and stressed that Indonesian migrant workers must use official channels when seeking employment abroad. Indonesia's ambassador to Russia described bilateral relations as "special" during National Day celebrations.

  • The Bogor district government and TNI inaugurated Koramil Tamansari-Dramaga to strengthen local security.
  • The Ministry of Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers said it is ready to meet Canada's healthcare worker needs.
  • A minister reminded migrant workers of the importance of departing through official channels after meeting trafficking victims.
  • An Indonesian migrant worker from Cianjur allegedly trafficked to Libya appealed to the president for help.
  • DPR member TB Hasanuddin revealed that Kopdes military training costs Rp 30 million per person.

Other

The government announced it has cut LNG prices to protect industry and jobs amid global energy market volatility. State logistics agency Bulog declared 200,000 tons of rice ready for export, while Indonesia also offered 10,000 tons of rice to Singapore. Danantara's COO announced plans to link all SOE whistleblowing systems with the KPK, with direct oversight of wealth reports and zero tolerance for violations.

  • Indonesia rolled out B50 biodiesel to strengthen energy security, according to BPDP.
  • The Supreme Court upheld UI's appeal, keeping sanctions on Bahlil dissertation supervisors valid.
  • The Constitutional Court ruled that voluntary pension benefits can be withdrawn either in lump sum or installments.
  • BPOM discovered 12 illegal herbal medicines containing chemicals, mostly marketed as male stamina enhancers.
  • The Health Minister requested support for annual TB screening in 532 prisons nationwide.
  • A labour union boss revealed the government will take over PT Granito if it closes and lays off workers.
